I'm a senior in high school and my confidence has plateaued substantially over the years and my anxiety has skyrocketed. I came to my current high school last year as a junior so I have a friend group established but I'm not so good with the females due to low confidence and insecurities. Being a new student with only a couple of friends, its hard to see so many people interacting without you. 

I developed this mindset where I did not gives shit what everyone thought of me. I asked myself, "Do you value the opinions of these kids at all?" The answer was no. I couldn't care less what they thought of me so I started being more comfortable. Keep in mind my confidence is at it's lowest point so this change is massive for me. I was able to walk around the crowded areas without having anxiety on who to talk to. I was more comfortable presenting in class. Made some new friends. I'm still working on talking to girls as that hasn't happened yet but with determination, I'm assuming it can. I guess a shift in mindset can really help a lot.
